requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/caseConvert.js` and your own tests in `tests/caseConvert.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `camelToSnake(text)` and `snakeToCamel(text)`. camelToSnake('myHTTPServer2') -> 'my_http_server2'; snakeToCamel('my_http_server') -> 'myHttpServer'. Leading/trailing/double underscores are dropped when converting to camel; already-converted input is returned unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Export `camelToSnake(text)` and `snakeToCamel(text)`. camelToSnake('myHTTPServer2') -> 'my_http_server2'; snakeToCamel('my_http_server') -> 'myHttpServer'. Leading/trailing/double underscores are dropped when converting to camel; already-converted input is returned unchanged.
